caption:
Koko is a nurse. Twelve hours walking the ward and bending over beds, and by the drive home the lower back and feet throb.

Bending over a low bed puts a lot on the lower back. Where you can, raising the bed to about waist height and working close to your body can often help.

Hybi's 1-minute break routine: calf stretch 30 seconds each side, lean gently back 5 times, 10 big shoulder rolls. Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier, alongside regular movement.

Leg numbness, one calf swollen and sore, or no change after two weeks is worth getting checked. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
